description: Intent i019 (SNAPSHOT=s03, branch=gro-frag-stale-ptr) complete. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i019.json, snapshots_checked=["s03"], 2 findings, 11 classified candidates. Finding 1 (medium): s03:net/ipv4/udp_offload.c:181-202 __skb_udp_tunnel_segment() — untrusted source is GSO UDP-tunnel super-packets (vxlan/geneve/fou, attacker-influenced inner bytes); struct udphdr *uh = udp_hdr(skb) captured at line 181, pskb_may_pull(skb, tnl_hlen) at line 189 with packet-layout-dependent tnl_hlen may __pskb_pull_tail -> pskb_expand_head and free skb->head for non-linear/cloned skbs; stale pre-pull uh dereferenced at line 199 (uh->len) and line 202 (uh->check), seeding 'partial' which is written into every generated segment's UDP header (lines 292-298) — the capture->reallocating-pull->stale-use shape of the seed's pep_get_sb(), same site the parallel s01 gro intent reported, still unfixed in s03. Finding 2 (low): s03:drivers/net/geneve.c:905-930 geneve_gro_receive() — attacker-controlled geneve GRO-hint option grows gh_len (nested_hdr_len) before a THIRD skb_gro_header(skb, off_gnv + gh_len, off_gnv) at line 913 that may pull/pskb_expand_head; gro_hint at line 917 is derived from the pre-third-pull gh (validated offsets fetched from one buffer) while gh is dereferenced post-pull in geneve_opt_gro_hint_validate_csum(skb, gh, gro_hint) at 918 and geneve_hdr_match(skb, gh, gh2, hint_off) at 927 without refetch — a validated-equals-used invariant break on the GRO path. Safe candidates with refetch discipline: vxlan_gro_prepare_receive (remcsum helper returns the refetched pointer which is reassigned), gre_offload.c greh = skb_gro_header_slow refetch, fou_core.c guehdr refetch, ip6_offload.c ipv6_gro_pull_exthdrs/ipv6_gro_receive iph refetch, af_inet.c inet_gro_receive (no pull before use), tcp_offload.c tcp_gro_pull_header (refetches inside helper), geneve_post_decap_hint (explicit refetch + untrusted-source comment), gro.c frag0 core. One unresolved: udp_gro_receive_segment is_flist branch (udp_offload.c:748-761) — whether uh is dereferenced after the pskb_may_pull(skb, skb_gro_offset(skb)) at line 749 was not conclusively traced. Limitations: all findings are static hypotheses (no KASAN reproducer; reallocation precondition is non-linear/cloned skb at the flagged pull); audit bounded to net/ and drivers/ GRO/GSO/frag-list files actually read; ~140 driver gro callbacks and xfrm/esp offload paths only pattern-listed; no network access to compare with upstream fixes; mac80211/mt76 and loop-parser RX sites excluded per parallel-intent coverage.
